name: The majority voted against amendments on [sheet 2838](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Famend%2Fr7181_amend_094e4841-f628-4dd7-b075-57a009342c75%22;rec=0) and [sheet 2839 revised](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Famend%2Fr7181_amend_cd041d39-8fa9-492d-8553-2fa500835e23%22;rec=0) to opposition amendments (1), (5) and (6) on [sheet 2651](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Famend%2Fr7181_amend_b90e4ab4-9de7-45be-8a75-52feafc59244%22;rec=0).
